name: AI Video for Marketing
description: Studio-grade AI video creation for marketing teams — cinematic campaigns, personalized to every customer with Variable Video Production, and proven end to end.

mainEntity.name: How does Flipick let a marketing team create campaign videos without an agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flipick turns a creative brief into a screenplay and storyboard you approve before a credit is spent. The finished, on-brand cinematic film is typically delivered inside a campaign cycle — no shoots, no back-and-forth with an agency, and no weeks of edit rounds.

mainEntity.name: What is Variable Video Production and how does it personalize a campaign video?

acceptedAnswer.text: Variable Video Production (VVP) takes a single master film and renders it into thousands of versions — by customer name, segment, city, language or offer. Each version is rendered from the film itself, not by overlaying text, so every field is part of the video.

mainEntity.name: Can Flipick deliver localized video ads for different markets without re-shooting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Flipick localizes one master production into every language and market you sell in — same brand, same look, with localized voice and on-screen text. No re-shoots and no separate agency engagements per region.

mainEntity.name: How does Flipick prove that a video actually moved the marketing funnel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every view is tied to a known recipient. Flipick tracks completion and CTA click-through per version, so marketing teams can report on outcomes, not just impressions, and know exactly which video version drove which result.
